name: Infernal Antlers
detailed_description:
Trapped in an endless war. Cursed by a deal with the Devil. Hunted by the horrors of the Hive.

You are the Devil Deer, a once-mortal creature who bargained away its soul to save its family. Now, you are nothing more than a weapon of the underworld, condemned to fight in realms beyond human comprehension. Your latest battlefield? A colossal, decaying Hive, its tunnels overrun by an undead plague.

In this top-down, wave-based zombie shooter, survival is only the beginning. Scavenge parts, build devastating weapons, and uncover the Hive’s darkest secrets. Will you forge hellish monstrosities of destruction or craft precise instruments of survival? Will you succumb to the Devil’s curse, or carve your path to freedom?

But beware—this is more than just survival. The Hive adapts, unleashing elite horrors, relentless mutations, and shifting battlegrounds that force you to rethink your every move. Tactical movement, smart weapon choices, and mastery of the battlefield will be the difference between life and death.
